create_dataset_writer: create a DatasetWriter with IntField and FloatField handlers to write a PyTorch dataset to FFCV format
write_from_indexed_dataset: write a PyTorch indexed dataset to an FFCV file using DatasetWriter.from_indexed_dataset with shuffle_indices
write_with_multiple_workers: write a dataset using DatasetWriter with 30 num_workers and a custom chunksize for parallel processing
read_ffcv_dataset: read an FFCV file with Reader and validate handlers, metadata, and field types match expectations
